# Kevin Eaton - Military

> Chaplain (Lieutenant Colonel) Kevin Eaton is a Chaplain in the U.S. Army Reserve with over 20 years of experience serving Soldiers, DA Civilians, and their Families, focused on Crisis Intervention, Suicide Prevention, and Pastoral Counseling.

This site covers his military service: highlights, awards and decorations, duty assignments, and rank promotions.

## More about Kevin Eaton

- [Hub / all sites](https://kevineaton.net): Links to all of Kevin's professional sites.
- [Technology](https://tech.kevineaton.net): Software architecture, engineering leadership, and entrepreneurship.
- [Academia](https://academia.kevineaton.net): University teaching experience and academic publications.
- [Martial Arts](https://martialarts.kevineaton.net): Taekwondo, Tangsoodo, Shotokan Karate, and weapons training.
